notes: Four distinct movable parts are counted: two separate leaves of the upper cabinet and one top drawer on each side of the range. The two cabinet leaves are closed in quick succession between frames 312 and 328; their exact closing order is somewhat ambiguous, but the leaves are retained as separate events.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both separate doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, opens the top drawer left of the range, closes the cabinet doors, opens the top drawer right of the range, and later closes both drawers.
